ExxonMobil's total revenues and other income rose about 1.5% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024. I took both figures from memory of the 10-K filings and did not search to confirm them.

- Fiscal 2023: about $344,582 million
- Fiscal 2024: about $349,585 million

The change is (349,585 − 344,582) / 344,582 ≈ +1.45%.

I used the "total revenues and other income" line. Sales and other operating revenue alone rose from about $334,697 million to $339,247 million, or about 1.4%.
